## Summary

This 337-amino-acid sequence is an **exact match** to the reviewed *Escherichia phage G4* minor spike protein (UniProt **P03647**; 100% identity and coverage). It is a viral structural protein associated with the phage particle. Its annotated roles include helping determine host range and participating in phage DNA ejection during infection; these functional descriptions are marked “by similarity” in the reference annotation.

| Feature | Result |
|---|---|
| Protein | Minor spike protein, *Escherichia phage G4* |
| Length | 337 aa |
| Estimated molecular mass | 35.7 kDa |
| Theoretical pI | 6.86 |
| Domain | Microvir_H (PF04687), residues 18–333 |
| Localization / GO | Virion; viral capsid (GO:0019028) |
| Additional GO term | Symbiont entry into host cell (GO:0046718) |
| Assembly annotation | Each of 12 spikes contains five G proteins and one H protein |

The mass and pI are sequence-derived estimates. The assembly and biological role are reference-protein annotations, not experimentally established by this sequence analysis alone.
